# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Command Line Tool Management

## 1. How do I install the command line tool?
To install the command line tool, run the following command in your terminal:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh
```
This script downloads and executes the installation process, which includes setting up dependencies and adding the tool to your PATH.

## 2. What if I encounter permission errors during installation?
If you see a "permission denied" error, run the installation script with sudo:
```bash
sudo curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh
```
